home.title: GeoLumica: Cities Future
home.subtitle: Analytical platform crossing Earth Observation data with official socio-economic records. We assess depopulation risk and economic change in rural areas by applying artificial intelligence at the municipal scale.

pillar1.title: Satellite Intelligence
pillar1.desc: Processing of monthly light radiance (VIIRS) to accurately measure the economic pulse at the municipal level.

pillar2.title: Land Connectivity
pillar2.desc: Topological analysis of the railway network (OSM) to determine the degree of isolation or integration of the territory.

pillar3.title: Predictive Modeling
pillar3.desc: Regression and clustering algorithms to identify patterns of population and economic decline for proactive solutions.

about.heroP1: The geographic landscape in many European countries, notably in Spain, is characterized by a sharp contrast between dynamic large urban centers and a vast network of towns and rural communities facing serious challenges. These challenges boil down to a persistent depopulation process, where lack of opportunities and disconnection cause a progressive decline.
about.heroP2_3: project was born to address this regional disparity. Its purpose is to generate advanced geospatial intelligence to map and understand the complex dynamics of urban growth and depopulation risk. By combining satellite night-time luminosity with socio-economic and railway data at an unprecedented level of
about.heroP2_5: , we offer a vital predictive tool.
about.quote1: Anticipate demographic decline before the process becomes
about.dataDesc1: Monthly satellite images (VIIRS) processed from Google Earth Engine to transform light radiance into municipal economic activity metrics.
about.dataDesc2: Massive download of the railway network via Overpass API. In-house calculation of connectivity, distances to the municipal centroid, and infrastructure density.
about.dataDesc3: Extraction of official and verified reality: demographic microdata, average income, and electricity consumption. The solid and historical foundation of our ML models.
about.teamDesc: A multidisciplinary approach combining Mathematical Engineering, Geospatial Analysis, and Machine Learning to respond to territorial challenges.
